scene: The token reveals three engraved destinations across Pixel City.
picture: Pixel art flat side view. On a level rooftop transit platform under dusk skies, from left to right: an ornate ferris wheel gondola docked at an iron platform, the tall Latino player holding the brass token, a brass-geared book cart lift waiting open, and a glowing purple night bus idling at a stop sign.
shown: a glowing ferris wheel gondola docked at an iron gate on the left
a mechanical book cart lift with an open gate in the centre
a purple night bus waiting at a roadside stop on the right
